source_shape: Broad upper round/slab outline with constant pale diamond-ring hub and phase-changing primary rim/face marks; fixed exposed lower crescent/slab below. All three native masks inspected. Exact spatial mounting/hidden slab depth is not established by glyph.

palette.primary: y on limestone slabs and recessed pore/groove shading
palette.detail: w only small central hub ring
palette.rule: Neutral limestone and separate central hub role; oyster-gray texture description does not replace actual source y/w palette.

native_state.native_timing: Retain AnimatedMaterialGeneric behavior including its own timing multiplier; no new clock or assumed milliseconds.
native_state.rare_animated: Original builder ChanceOneIn15000/RailedMechanism/CookingAndGathering retained as native fallback; no actor conversion invented.

findings: Mill processes items/transforms on EndTurn when ready and consumes charge; native recipe/container behavior is not reimplemented.

AnimatedMaterialGeneric.Render checks RequiresOperationalActivePart status, passing actual ActivePartStatusIgnoreSubject field through StatusOf. Thus source true ignores subject presence for art phase eligibility, not all operational constraints.
No generated dust, hopper fill, grain props, extra idle/off sprite or new timing is inferred from description.
native_code_study.scope: Static installed metadata/class study; no native replacement validation.

native_behavior: MechanicalPowerTransmission consumer100, MillChargeUse1, actual named/tag transformations and container/inventory remain native. AV10/HP500/weight300, examiner2/difficulty1, non-buildable/non-disassemblable BBtinker, native rare animation and operational behavior preserved.

reference.equivalence: Partial upright stone material reference. Qud broad exposed round slabs/hub and native poses authoritative.

construction.camera: One fixed source map face with parallel slab presentation and shallow stone edge thickness; no yaw/turntable or imported donor edge-on view.
construction.source_supported: Upper changing round stone/rim, invariant detail hub at8,8.5 and fixed lower exposed rounded slab across all3source masks.
construction.authored: Filled limestone stone faces behind sparse source rim/marks, soft perimeter, shallow rim thickness, carved radial seams and subtle shell/porosity. Exact depth/slab mounting unknown. Upper radial texture angles are authored0,+40,-40 degrees to distinguish source phase tendencies, not recovered angular measurements or native timing.
construction.rule: One default material refinement; rigidly map only upper stone material/ink through authored phase angles, fixed lower slab and hub remain identical. No independently generated body or bounds fit per phase.

frame.rule: Same full cell/centers/scale/pivot and y/w roles in all3phases.
